observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 173.» (L11) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 46: 20 stands beside «CAPUT XLVI.», a little below its baseline, 25 beside L20.
body L17-L18: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in one line.
body L10: «’l–qarnayn» is printed with a dash longer than the hyphens of the page.
body L11: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) read «114,11, in minutis apogei Martis pro 18′ l. 58′.»; the printed «126° 18′» is kept (cfr. note 4).
notes_left L1: the addenda et emendanda read «114, adn. 1: Transpositio nonnisi in editionibus Platonis; cfr. praefationem p. LV.»
body L19, L20: a stroke drawn by hand in the scanned copy crosses the q and the u of «aequatum» and the first e and the ss of «regressuum»; the letters are read under it.
body L25: in «54′» the diagonal stroke of the 4 did not print; its crossbar and stem are printed (the first 4 of Saturn's 244° on L11 is printed thin in the same place).
notes_right L1: the day of «I Sept.» is printed as a capital I, without the flag that the figure 1 has; kept as printed.
notes_right L4: نح (58) and يح (18) are the minutes in Arabic letters, each a tooth joined to the ḥā'; in يح the two dots of the yā' are printed joined into one, inside the bowl of the ḥā'.
notes_right L5-L6: ♄ ♃ ♂ ♀ ☿ are the signs of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury; Plato's value for Mercury is printed «501° 58′»; kept as printed.
notes_right L6: the letter of «adnot. d» is bold italic.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
